title: Treasury Administrator
description:
Who we are

GlobalData operates an intelligence platform that empowers leaders to act decisively in a world of complexity and change.

By uniting proprietary data, human expertise, and purpose-built AI into a single, connected platform, we help organisations see what s coming, move faster, and lead with confidence.

Our solutions are used by over 5,000 organisations across the world s largest industries, delivering tailored intelligence that supports strategic planning, innovation, risk management, and sustainable growth.

Why join GlobalData?

GlobalData is at a pivotal point in its growth journey, and we need curious, ambitious, courageous people to support us in achieving our vision to deliver intelligence that transforms uncertainty into opportunity for the world s most successful organisations.?

Our big ambitions mean that life at GlobalData is fast-paced, entrepreneurial and rewarding. Working together in an intellectually challenging environment, where learning is super-charged to keep us on our toes, the highly stimulating, fast-paced, global environment we operate in, and our bold ambitions result in unique learning opportunities for our people.

The role

We now have an opening for a Treasury Administrator within the Treasury Team based in Hull. Working within the finance team, we expect you to have close interaction with the wider commercial business, with the main responsibility being production of daily bank reconciliations and processing of payments.

Now is an incredibly exciting time to join and be part of a business that is fast-paced, vibrant and ambitious, with opportunities for everyone to develop and succeed.

What you ll be doing
- Producing daily bank reconciliations in multi currencies
- Cash allocation of bank receipts and payments
- Resolving cash allocation queries
- Ledger maintenance
- Liaising with purchase ledger, credit control
- Creation of manual purchase ledger payments
- Bank and credit card administration

What we re looking for
- AAT Qualified, or experience of working in a similar role.
- Technical skills - with strong Excel skills and analytical ability.
- Dedicated and accountable - able to meet deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail and effectively managing expectations.
- Organised - able to meet deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail as well as managing expectations effectively.
- A strong communicator - able to communicate well and build strong, collaborative relationships across the business.
- Adaptable and positive mindset - a confident personality with a positive attitude towards change and new challenges.

In addition to a rewarding career, we support our GlobalData colleagues with a range of benefits across health, finances, fitness, travel, tech and more. To find out more about the roles and benefits on offer in your region, visit (url removed)

GlobalData believes strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. GlobalData is determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

title: Customer Service Assistant (PFI)
description:
Job Title: Customer Service Assistant
Contract Type: Fixed term up to 20/02/2028
Salary: £26,251.43 per annum (pro rata)
Working Hours: 23.3 hours per week, part time
Working Pattern: 3 week rolling rota covering a mix of early shifts (09:00 - 14:30) Late shifts (14:30 - 20:00) and weekend day shifts (09:00 - 17:00 with 1/2 hour unpaid break) You will also cover some bank holidays as part of the rota as we operate 365 days per year
Location: Hull - Primarily based at Harrison Park (Hall Road) but will cover where needed at Cecil Gardens (Hawthorne Avenue) and Redwood Glades (Leads Road)

If you share our values and are excited about making a significant impact at Riverside, please ensure you attach a current CV and covering letter. At Riverside we recruit to potential not just on skills and experience, so we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the essential criteria on the job description.

Please note that whilst we will accept applications on the basis of any form of valid legal permission to work in the UK, we will be surrendering the Riverside Sponsorship licence, so for the avoidance of doubt, we are unable to apply for any further sponsorships whether on behalf of existing colleagues or candidates.

The difference you will make as a Customer Service Assistant
You will be responsible for providing a professional, customer-focused reception service within one of Riverside's extra care facilities, handling all enquiries and welcoming customers and visitors in a busy, modern housing environment.

About you
We are looking for someone with:
- Experience of working within a housing or support environment
- Good communication and conflict resolution skills
- Organisational skills
- Experience working with vulnerable customers

Why Riverside?
At Riverside, we're a housing association with a difference - enhancing the everyday for all our customers. For 90 years, we've been revitalising neighbourhoods and supporting communities by providing the homes they need to live full, fulfilling and rewarding lives.
We have a portfolio of over 75,000 affordable residential and retirement homes across the UK. Our work ranges from homelessness services to social care, employment support to retirement living, and we need the best people on board to help us.

Working with us, you'll enjoy:
- Competitive pay & generous pension
- 25 days holidays plus bank holidays (pro rata)
- Investment in your learning, personal development and technology
- A wide range of benefits

Diversity and Inclusion at Riverside:
We are inclusive. At Riverside, we value diversity in all its forms. We foster a workplace where all individuals are respected, empowered, and heard. Our commitment to inclusivity drives our success and enriches the lives of our customers and colleagues.
Riverside is a Disability Confident Employer and operates a Guaranteed Interview Scheme for any applicant who declares they have a disability. If the applicant meets the minimum requirements for the role (as set out in the role profile and/or person specification) they will be guaranteed an interview.

Applications may close before the deadline, so please apply early to be considered.

title: Account Coordinator
Temporary Bookkeeper
description:
Are you a detail-oriented and adaptable Bookkeeper looking for a hands-on role within a small business? Are you used to a stand alone position where you can support the finance function and look at ways to make efficiencies? Are you immediately available and able to work in a temporary contract for a well established business who need additional support to process a backlog of work in the first instance.

Our client, a well-established and growing manufacturer based in the Bridlington area, is seeking a temporary Bookkeeper to join their team and support them with a backlog of accounts work.

They are looking for an enthusiastic individual to take on a crucial role, providing essential financial support and contributing to the smooth operation of the business.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with solid bookkeeping experience, particularly with Sage, who is eager to become an integral part of a hands-on SME.

What the Bookkeeper job involves

You ll play a key role in managing the daily financial operations, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.
- Raising customer invoices and delivery notes on a daily basis.
- Managing the invoice factoring process.
- Daily monitoring of bank accounts and cashflow.
- Payroll administration, collating employee hours each week from a clocking in system and send to payroll.
- Matching invoices and accurately allocating payments within Sage.

This is a varied and fast-paced role that would suit someone who enjoys being at the heart of an operational team, managing multiple financial priorities, and providing excellent administrative support.

Skills required

We re looking for candidates who can demonstrate a practical approach and a willingness to contribute beyond traditional bookkeeping duties. Ideal candidates will have:
- Proven experience with Sage 50 would be beneficial.
- The ability to manage and allocate payments efficiently within Sage.
- Self managed and able to work on their own initiative.
- A high degree of adaptability and flexibility to take on a range of tasks as needed.
- Previous experience in bookkeeping from a small / medium size business.

This role would suit someone who is not afraid to contribute to a busy, hands-on environment.

Other information
- Working hours are initially 10 AM to 4 PM, Monday to Friday.
- On-site car parking available.
- Own transport is essential due to the location.

This vacancy is being advertised through KD Recruitment Limited who are operating as an Employment Agency.

Due to the volume of applications we receive if you have not heard from us within 2 weeks, please assume you have not been short listed for this particular role.

KD Recruitment Limited is committed to a policy of equal opportunities in relation to job applications and we are also committed to protecting your personal data. If you would like to read our privacy policy, please go to our website (url removed) where you will find all the information you need to know about how we will use and process your personal data.

You can also follow us on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn for up to date jobs and other helpful information.

title: Project Administrator
company: Consortium Professional Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Project Administrator
Location: Brough
Salary: Up to £30,000 depending on experience
Bring Your Organisation and Technical Skills to a Role Where Every Detail Matters
Are you an organised, detail-focused professional who enjoys keeping projects on track? Do you have experience interpreting technical drawings, processing orders and coordinating multiple priorities in a busy environment?
Consortium Professional Recruitment are pleased to be partnering with an established business to recruit a Project Administrator. This is an excellent opportunity to join a small, supportive team where your ability to manage information, solve problems and keep projects moving will make a genuine difference.
The Opportunity: As a Project Administrator, you'll play a key role in:
- Reviewing technical drawings, specifications and customer requirements to ensure accurate information is captured and processed.
- Processing customer orders, checking details and coordinating information to support projects from initial enquiry through to completion.
- Managing multiple projects and their moving parts, including quotations, supplier information, lead times and changing customer requirements.
- Liaising with customers, suppliers and internal colleagues to resolve queries, communicate updates and keep projects progressing.
- Maintaining accurate records, tracking outstanding actions and identifying potential issues before they affect delivery.

Your work will directly contribute to the smooth running of projects, helping a close-knit team deliver an accurate, responsive and reliable service to customers.
About You: We're looking for someone who can bring:
- Technical understanding: The ability to confidently read and interpret technical drawings, specifications and measurements.
- Relevant experience: Previous experience in project administration, project coordination, technical administration or a similar role involving multiple projects and competing priorities.
- Order processing experience: Confidence handling customer orders, checking information and maintaining accurate documentation.
- Attention to detail: A methodical approach to your work, with the ability to identify discrepancies and ensure information is correct.
- Resilience and adaptability: The confidence to manage changing priorities, work through challenges and remain focused when things get busy.
- Teamwork and communication: A collaborative approach, with the ability to build positive working relationships in a small team and communicate effectively with customers and suppliers.

Experience within an engineering, manufacturing, construction or technical environment would be advantageous, alongside familiarity with Excel and digital systems.
You don't need to have followed one particular career path. If you've developed these skills in a similar project-focused environment, we'd welcome your application.
The Benefits and Package: In return, you'll enjoy:
- Salary: Up to £30,000 depending on experience.
- Location: Brough.
- The opportunity to work within a small, collaborative team where your contribution will be valued.
- A varied role offering involvement across different stages of customer projects.

How to Apply: This exciting Project Administrator opportunity is being managed by Consortium Professional Recruitment, a trusted recruitment partner. If you're ready to bring your technical understanding, organisational skills and attention to detail to a varied new challenge, we'd love to hear from you.
Please apply with your CV attached.

title: Financial Services Administrator
description:
Financial Services Administrator

Beverley

£27,000-£30,000

NJR Recruitment is working with a well-established and growing financial planning practice in Beverley to recruit an experienced Financial Services Administrator to join its dedicated support team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a background in financial services administration who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, takes pride in delivering exceptional client service and is looking to develop their career within a supportive and professional team.

Working closely with Financial Advisers, you will play an integral role in ensuring the smooth running of client administration, supporting the team with new business processing, client queries, provider liaison and maintaining accurate client records.

The Role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing new client applications and onboarding, ensuring all paperwork is completed accurately.
- Supporting the processing of client investment transactions in line with internal procedures and compliance requirements.
- Liaising directly with clients to obtain information and complete outstanding administration.
- Managing client queries and providing a professional, efficient and friendly service.
- Liaising with providers to obtain plan, policy and scheme information.
- Assisting with technical calculations, including carry forward allowances, critical yield analysis and Inheritance Tax calculations.
- Maintaining accurate client records and updating CRM systems.
- Inputting and checking client fact-find information.
- Preparing reports and presentations to support Financial Advisers with client meetings.
- Ensuring all administration is completed accurately and in line with FCA and compliance requirements.
- Contributing to the improvement of internal processes and procedures.

About You

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- At least 2 years' experience within a Financial Services Administration role.
- Experience working within an IFA or financial planning environment.
- A good understanding of financial services products, processes and FCA requirements.
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office, and ideally experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM system.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage and prioritise a varied workload.
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal.
- A proactive, positive approach and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £27,000-£30,000 depending on experience.
- Discretionary bonus scheme of up to 15% of salary.
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Workplace pension.
- Death in service benefit of 4 x annual salary.
- Opportunities for salary progression and further development.
- A supportive working environment within an established and growing financial planning business.
- Early finish on Fridays

If you have experience within financial services administration and are looking for your next opportunity within a supportive financial planning practice, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact NJR Recruitment for a confidential discussion quoting NJR100071

description: You'll support patients and service users through a welcoming reception service, helping them access the right care and information. As part of the Customer Service team, you will be an important first point of contact for patients, carers and partner organisations. You will help ensure enquiries are handled accurately, respectfully and on time. What you'll do: Welcome patients and visitors, respond to enquiries and signpost people to appropriate services Answer calls, process messages, emails and referrals, and book appointments where appropriate Keep patient records accurate, up to date and confidential Organise your workload and support the smooth running of clinics and reception services Work with colleagues across different health centre's and provide flexible cover when needed Level 3 Business Administration or Customer Service qualification, or equivalent knowledge and experience Experience of office administration and a good understanding of administrative processes Confidence using Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook Good organisation, communication and time management skills, with strong attention to detail A respectful, flexible approach and the ability to work well within a team Please see the job description and person specification attached to this job advert for full details on the role.

title: Care Navigator / Receptionist
location: HESSLE, HU13 9LZ, Brough, HU15 2JG, Brough, HU15 1AY, York, YO43 4BJ, Selby, YO8 6LY
description: We are recruiting a Care Navigator/Receptionist to join our busy and friendly team, providing a high quality service to patients, doctors and other members of the Primary Healthcare Team. Working 30 hours per week across our sites at Hessle, Brough, South Cave, Bubwith and Holme on Spalding Moor (HOSM). Wednesday: 8:00am-6:00pm Thursday: 8:00am-6:00pm Friday: 8:00am-6:00pm Candidates should be experienced in delivering excellent reception support, maintaining professionalism and discretion at all times and be able to work independently and as part of a team. Good communication skills and attention to detail are essential along with the flexibility to cover for annual/sick leave. Knowledge of SystmOne would be an advantage. You will have experience of working with the public, have a cheerful and polite manner, be able to multi-task and be a good team player. You must be able to contribute to the maintenance of patient confidentiality at all times, inside and outside the Practice. Interview Date: Monday, 4th January 2026 at our Brough Practice. For more information on salary and working hours, please see attached documents. You will need to be a good communicator with excellent interpersonal and customer service skills; especially under pressure. You will have a range of patient facing and administrative tasks, so excellent organisational skills and time management are critical. A caring, empathetic character is essential. Your duties will include answering telephone calls, registering patients and general admin within the Practice. It is very important to have a 'can do' attitude. It is also important to be flexible and able cover shifts when required. PLEASE SEE ATTACHED JOB DESCRIPTION FOR THE FULL LIST OF DUTIES. Greet patients and visitors to the Practice. Book in patients and visitors in line with Practice appointments and visitors procedures. Respond and/or redirect all patient and visitor requests accordingly and ensure unresolved and urgent matters are passed onto incoming colleagues at end of shift. Opening incoming mail and distribute as per protocol. Booking, amending, and cancelling patient appointments. Recording patient information onto the clinical system. Ensure waiting room temperature is comfortable for patients and responsible for tidying the waiting area (magazines, toys etc.) after each surgery Answering incoming telephone calls, ensuring calls are documented and redirected accordingly. Care Navigate all patients, including referring patients to outside providers. Book appointments using Improving Access System. Must be flexible to provide holiday and sickness cover on a regular basis. Maintenance of both computerised and manual filing systems (scanning, filing etc.). Ring Tasks sent by Clinicians using the flagged system. Prescriptions Hand paper copies to patients when Dispensary is closed. Make tea/coffee for colleagues, doctors and visitors as required Work safely at all times in accordance with Legislative requirements and Practice Policy and Procedures. Administration Duties Registrations, New Patient Questionnaires and Deductions must be kept up to date. Any other additional administration duties as required. This job description is not exhaustive and may be adjusted periodically after review and consultation. You will also be expected to carry out any reasonable duties which may be requested from time-to-time.
